user.title: Add DiFluid Device
user.description: Add another Bluetooth device, or add the brew detector that reads your scale.

device.title: Add DiFluid Device
device.description: Select a nearby DiFluid device, or choose **Enter MAC address manually** if nothing appears.

detector.title: Add Brew Detector
detector.description:
The brew detector watches a scale's weight stream and works out doses, pours and shot ratios. It owns the brew statistics and appears as its own device.

The refractometer is optional and is not used yet.

mac.title: Add DiFluid Device (MAC)
mac.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your DiFluid device (format: `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`). Find it in the DiFluid app or via nRF Connect.

error.invalid_address: Invalid MAC address format. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.no_scale: Add a scale first — the brew detector has nothing to read without one.

init.title: Brew detector
init.description: Thresholds for detecting the bean dose and the pour on the weight stream. Defaults suit an 18 g dose and a 35-42 g espresso. Raise **dose_min_hold_seconds** if a portafilter left briefly on the scale is being mistaken for a dose; lower it if a quick weighing is missed.

data.stable_time_fraction: Share of the window that must hold (0-1)
data.settle_min_seconds: Accept a value removed after only (s)
data.dose_min_hold_seconds: Dose must be held for at least (s)
data.dose_min_rise_seconds: Dose must have taken at least this long to arrive (s)
data.gap_reset_seconds: Treat a hole in the stream as a break after (s)

error.invalid_range_order: A minimum is above its maximum. Dose, yield and ratio each need minimum ≤ maximum, or the detector can never match anything.

abort.no_options: Nothing to configure here. The brew detector's thresholds live on the Brew Detector entry.
